This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase that sets the place of an action normally comes before the main verb; here 墓地里 modifies 玩. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，To express pretending to carry out an action, use 假装 + verb phrase; 装 does not naturally take 祭拜 in this meaning. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩：孟子是一个小男孩。小的时候，他从早到晚都跟朋友玩，On first mention, introduce the character with a brief noun phrase before using the name and later pronouns. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家：孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家了，This is a completed move in the narrative, so the action needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动作动词“玩”之前。
“装祭拜”搭配不自然，“假装祭拜”可以正确表达假装进行祭拜。
人物首次出现时需要先用简短说明介绍孟子。
这里叙述的是已经完成的搬家事件，动词后应有“了”。
